nadia (eng-sre): Postmortem INC-1900 is up. Root cause: KV cache eviction cascade + autoscaler lag. Need quick runbook edits and owners.

nadia (eng-sre): Short action items: 1) KV triage block (owner: tara, due: 2025-06-02). 2) Containment 'safe-mode' commands + diagnostics (owner: jon, due: 2025-06-04). 3) Explicit autoscaler-failure escalation ladder (owner: ash, due: 2025-06-01). 4) Tag recurring-pattern and add 30d review (owner: nadia, due: 2025-06-15).

tara (eng-platform): I'll add checks for cache hit ratio, eviction rate, TTL skew, plus a one-click fallback toggle.

jon (eng-runtime): Taking safe-mode. Draft snippet for runbook for quick copy/paste:

```
# safe-mode: reduce concurrency and set readonly cache
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-api KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly
kubectl -n inference exec deployment/inference-api -- python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=20
```

jon (eng-runtime): I'll include example outputs and a grep summary for oncall.

ash (infra): For escalation ladder propose: @oncall-sre -> @platform-pager if no ack in 5m -> page infra lead after 15m -> exec manager after 30m. I'll add rotation links.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook created by tara: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-1900-draft PR #503. Reminder set: runbook walkthrough 2025-06-03 14:00 UTC (invite sent).

nadia (eng-sre): After walkthrough, merge PR and tag runbook header with postmortem link and recurring-pattern. Closing thread once merged. :thumbsup:
